name: The 2030 retiree's pension ten years later: the exempt amount shrinks
workings: 2% inflation a year since 2026: prices are 1.02^15 = 1.345868 times 2026's; the pension is unchanged in today's euros
The exempt amount was fixed in 2031 at 2,857.3440 in 2031's euros, 3,154.7387 nominal; in today's euros now 2,344.0173
The €102 and €36 lump sums are fixed in nominal euros too: 75.7875 and 26.7485 today
The tariff keeps its value (indexThresholds on, after 2026); the contributions are the same in today's euros
Taxable income: 20,409.60 − 2,344.0173 − 75.7875 − 2,643.0432 − 26.7485 = 15,320.0035; T = 496.857368, 103.91 more than in 2031: fiscal drag on the exemption and the lump sums
Changed from the drafted case (see DE.md, Reference cases), which kept the lump sums at their nominal value although the design fixes them in nominal euros
